admission.justification: Cleanup deletes artifacts irreversibly. Existing partial-failure, interrupted-request and changed-request controls bind safe recovery to the same retained proof; this is the recovery half of the publication/protection/recovery family.

applicability: Repeated task_doc.retire_master requests admitted against one retained proof and its actual operation state.
conditions: The repeated request matches the recording owner, reason, edge selection and namespace.
Recorded sources remain readable and agree with the retained proof.
Once cleanup deletes an artifact it is not recreated.
exclusions: A fresh first-phase refusal creates no retirement or cleanup authority.
Generic edits cannot rewrite a retained retirement row.

evidence: MIK-R41@v4; original33 MR1-A01/K02/W04 and exact current source, statically inspected; no fresh functional execution claim.

statement: An identical retained retirement request completes only remaining state transitions: an interrupted sprint edit rewrites its JSON/Markdown pair before archival; after archival cleanup failure keeps the retirement and reports ok=false/retired-with-hook-failures, with stale projection refresh and remaining cleanup on retry. A differing reason, edge selection or namespace refuses without recreating deleted artifacts.
